rewrite.description: Modify request body fields with a JSON operation array
rewrite.empty: No request rewrite rules yet. Click "Add rule" to create the first one

failover.description: Automatically fail over to a fallback provider when the primary provider fails
failover.empty: No failover rules yet. Click "Add rule" to create the first one

form.dimensionHint: When a request fails, failover is performed along this dimension.
form.autoDisableYesHint: Yes: after failover candidates are exhausted, the affected {{target}} is marked disabled (subject to the disable threshold below).
form.autoDisableNoHint: No: each time it only moves to the next candidate and never auto-disables.
form.patternsLabel: Auto-trigger when the upstream error field contains these keywords
form.patternsPlaceholder:
One keyword or error code per line
429
rate_limit_exceeded
insufficient_quota
form.patternsHint: One per line; failover triggers when any line appears in the upstream error. Leave empty to trigger only by the conditions below.
form.speedHint: 0 means no limit. Greater than 0 means an average request speed (total tokens ÷ total time including connection) below N token/s also counts as a failure toward the disable threshold (OR with matching fields).
form.ttfbHint: 0 disables this condition. Greater than 0 means a first-byte response slower than N seconds also triggers failover (OR with matching fields).
form.thresholdHint: Disable only after N consecutive hits within the window. Window 0 means no time limit; count 1 means "disable on the first hit".

response.description: Apply to response fields in order: rename / prefix / suffix / delete
